name: The Drunken Demon Inn, Stairwell
desc1: This small chamber serves only as a connecting point between the
desc2: upstairs and the downstairs, as a wide wooden stair filled with creaky
desc3: steps leads to the second floor where the bedrooms are. It also is
desc4: used by the kitchen staff, who rush in and out of the kitchen to the
desc5: tavern hall with drink and food.
